# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 16 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-15 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_bard_level15_widening.rs) to level 16 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/performance posture from the level-1 through level-15
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The PF1
# Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-16 "Special" column is genuinely
# BLANK — verified independently against three primary sources (d20pfsrd,
# the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, and legacy.aonprd.com's
# corerulebook mirror, all three byte-for-byte identical: "+12/+7/+2 | +5 |
# +10 | +10 | —"), resolving a prior cycle's carried-forward risk-map note
# that had claimed a source disagreement ("Versatile performance" on
# aonprd.com) — that text turns out to belong to level 14's own Special
# column ("Frightening tune, Versatile performance", already grounded by
# tests/sd18_bard_level14_widening.rs), misattributed to level 16 by an
# earlier cycle's transcription, exactly mirroring the sorcerer-level16
# cycle's own lesson about carried-forward risk-map drift. So no new choice
# line or class-feature grant is required this slice: base attack bonus and
# both good saves (Reflex, Will) genuinely rise (16*3/4=12, 16/2+2=10), poor
# Fortitude stays unchanged (16/3=5, an integer-division coincidence with
# level 15), Bardic Knowledge genuinely rises (max(16/2,1)=8), the Bardic
# Performance rounds-per-day pool genuinely rises (4+CHA+2*(16-1)=36), and
# the Fascinate DC/affected-creature-count and Frightening Tune's DC all
# genuinely rise (10+16/2+CHA=20, 1+(16-1)/3=6).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion execution, no Dirge of Doom execution,
# no Inspire Greatness execution, no untrained-skill-use execution for
# Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master take-10/take-20 execution against any
# actual Knowledge check, no Soothing Performance healing/condition-removal
# execution, no Frightening Tune fear-resolution execution, no Inspire
# Heroics targeting/save/AC-application execution, and no spontaneous
# known-spell / slot posture burden.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level16
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:16
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
